summary: Frontend-only testing of SearchableSelect migration + Dashboard 'Nouvelle intervention' button + compressor hourly counter. All requested flows validated via Playwright on the public URL.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' when container not yet sized - cosmetic, non-blocking (pre-existing)
React warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby - a11y improvement, non-blocking

The 'Clock' recent-indicator icon renders (lucide-react svg without .lucide-clock class) but is not easily targetable via .lucide-clock selector; functional ordering (last-selected on top) works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: SearchableSelect stores 'last selected' by data-testid; components without a data-testid won't get the recent behavior. Verified major pages all pass data-testid.
Consider adding DialogDescription to intervention create Dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
